content:
Doc purpose
- Draft rollout plan for Provision-to-Ready Automation (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management sprint).
- Audience: Infra/Fleet, Platform Control Plane, SRE, Release Engineering, Observability.
- This is meant to be practical/operational. Expect updates as we learn from us-east A100.

Owner / DRI
- Release DRI: Connor O'Brien (Release Engineering)
- Technical rollout leads: Vanessa Ortiz (Fleet), Ethan Park (Control Plane)
- On-call readiness: Rafael Mendes (SRE), Harish Reddy (Fleet Ops)

Summary
We will enable the new provision-to-ready workflow in stages behind feature flags scoped by region + GPU type + pool type. Initial launch is limited to us-east + A100 + Dedicated pools only. We will keep an explicit kill switch and a well-defined rollback path to (a) bypass readiness gates, and (b) revert image channel promotion / provisioning orchestration steps if failure rates or time-to-ready regress.

Rollout goals (what “success” looks like)
- Reduce provision-to-ready P95 for Dedicated pool expansion by a meaningful margin (target to be finalized in SLO doc; current proposal: P95 <= 90 min in steady state for supported regions/SKUs).
- Achieve >= 98% success rate of nodes reaching Ready without manual intervention during rollout window (excluding known provider capacity errors).
- Keep paging noise bounded (no more than 1 page/day attributable to rollout after the first 48 hours).
- Demonstrate safe rollback: can disable new workflow and return to legacy/partial behavior within 15 minutes.

Key concepts / flags (current naming; confirm in PR-18433 before enabling)
- provisioning_orchestrator.enabled: Enables orchestration steps beyond “instance allocated”.
- readiness_state_machine.enabled: Enables control-plane persistence of Allocated/Provisioning/Validating/Ready/Quarantined states.
- readiness_gate.enforce_before_serving: Prevents nodes from joining serving pools until Ready (PR-18496).
- validation_agent.enabled: Deploys node validation agent DaemonSet and runs validation suite.
- validation_checks.nccl_smoke_test: Enables NCCL all-reduce smoke test.
- image_channel.policy: candidate/stable pinning and promotion policy for a pool.
- quarantine_policy.enabled: Enables auto-quarantine after repeated validation failures.

Flag scoping
- Scope keys: region, gpu_type, pool_type (dedicated/shared), pool_id allowlist.
- Default posture: flags off globally; allowlist on for rollout targets.

Proposed staged rollout plan

Stage 0 — Pre-rollout readiness (T-7 to T-1 days)
Objective: Get observability + runbooks + access in place before any production enablement.

Checklist
- Dashboards live and verified with sample data:
  - Provision-to-ready latency breakdown by step (P50/P95)
  - Failure rate by step
  - Quarantine counts and top quarantine reasons
  - Validation flake rate (especially NCCL)
- Alerts created but initially set to “ticket” (not paging) during first 24–48h.
- Runbook reviewed for safe remediation order (drain -> quarantine -> reimage) and escalation paths.
- Access confirmed:
  - Infra/SRE on-call can access readiness dashboards and readiness service UI/endpoints.
  - Least-privilege approvals completed (track internal requests separately).
- Change management entry drafted for release train notes.

Stage 1 — Internal dogfood / non-critical pools (Day 1)
Scope
- Region: us-east
- GPU: A100 only
- Pool type: Dedicated only
- Pool allowlist: 1–2 internal/test Dedicated pools (non-customer-facing) used for fleet operations testing.

Enablement sequence
1) Turn on readiness_state_machine.enabled (read-only UI path OK).
2) Turn on validation_agent.enabled with a minimal validation set (GPU health + driver parity + kubelet join checks).
3) Turn on provisioning_orchestrator.enabled.
4) Keep readiness_gate.enforce_before_serving OFF for this stage.

Go/no-go criteria (end of Day 1)
- >= 90% nodes reach Ready without manual intervention.
- No “unknown” state transitions or missing state write anomalies in control plane.
- No major metric cardinality issues (watch for tag explosion regressions).

Stage 2 — Customer-facing canary (Day 2–3)
Scope
- Region: us-east
- GPU: A100 only
- Pool type: Dedicated
- Pool allowlist: 1 small/medium customer Dedicated pool expansion event (coordinate w/ Support + CSM), plus 1 internal pool.

Enablement sequence
1) Keep Stage 1 flags.
2) Enable readiness_gate.enforce_before_serving for the allowlisted pools.
3) Enable quarantine_policy.enabled with conservative thresholds (see “Quarantine posture”).

Go/no-go criteria (after first customer expansion)
- Provision-to-ready P95 is non-regressive vs baseline for same SKU/region (or explainable by provider constraints).
- Quarantine rate <= 3% of provisioned nodes OR clear, actionable failure reasons with remediations.
- No customer-facing throughput incidents attributable to capacity shortfall caused by readiness gating/quarantine.

Stage 3 — us-east A100 general availability for Dedicated expansions (Day 4–7)
Scope
- Region: us-east
- GPU: A100
- Pool type: Dedicated
- Allowlist broadened to all Dedicated pools in us-east A100 (or “all new nodes” only).

Enablement sequence
- Gradually widen allowlist in batches (e.g., 25% of pools -> 50% -> 100%) with monitoring in between.
- Introduce NCCL smoke test (validation_checks.nccl_smoke_test) only after baseline validation suite is stable.

Stop/hold criteria
- Any SLO breach sustained > 30 minutes.
- Pager volume exceeds agreed thresholds.
- Quarantine causes capacity shortfall for any Dedicated pool (see rollback triggers).

Stage 4 — Expand to additional GPU types in us-east (Week 2, pending)
Candidate order (subject to driver/toolkit matrix readiness)
- H100 next (if image channel is validated and NCCL/network tests behave)
- L40S/L4 last (different perf profiles; ensure validations are meaningful)

Stage 5 — Expand to second region (Week 2–3, pending)
Candidate region order (draft)
1) us-west (similar operational patterns; good for redundancy)
2) eu-west (adds cross-region variance + compliance constraints)
3) ap-southeast (only after we have stable automation + clear provider constraints)

Notes
- Region ordering should prioritize: (a) fleet maturity, (b) consistent networking/fabric characteristics, (c) SRE coverage.

Quarantine posture (initial conservative defaults)
- Auto-quarantine only after N repeated failures of the same validation step (proposed N=2 within a 60-minute window) OR hard-fail conditions:
  - GPU health: Xid / ECC error thresholds exceeded (as defined by Infra validation checklist)
  - Driver/toolkit parity mismatch vs pinned golden image version
  - Kubelet join failure after max retries
- Operator override allowed: “unquarantine + revalidate” for known transient failures.
- Always attach failure reason + artifact pointer (logs bundle location) to prevent blind quarantines.

Rollback plan
We need two rollback levels: “soft rollback” (disable gating/validations) and “hard rollback” (revert image channel and/or orchestration).

Soft rollback (target <= 15 minutes)
When
- Validation flake spikes (e.g., NCCL false negatives) or readiness gating blocks serving capacity.
Actions
- Turn OFF readiness_gate.enforce_before_serving for affected region/GPU/pools.
- Optionally keep state machine on, but treat Ready as “best effort” (do not block serving).
- Reduce validation suite to minimal checks (GPU health + driver parity) if needed.
Impact
- Nodes may join serving pools sooner; may increase risk of latent hardware/network issues.

Hard rollback (target <= 60 minutes)
When
- Evidence that new golden image is faulty OR orchestrator changes are causing systemic failures.
Actions
- Revert pool image channel from candidate -> last known stable.
- Disable provisioning_orchestrator.enabled for affected scope (falls back to legacy bring-up steps).
- Consider pausing new allocations/expansions for impacted pools until stabilized.

Rollback triggers (draft; finalize w/ SRE)
Operational triggers
- Provision-to-ready success rate < 95% over 1 hour for the rollout scope (excluding provider capacity allocation failures).
- Quarantine rate > 5% over 1 hour OR quarantine causes > 10% capacity reduction in any customer Dedicated pool.
- Time-to-ready P95 increases by > 25% compared to baseline for same region/GPU type for 2 consecutive measurement windows.
- Any Sev2+ incident attributable to rollout.
- Any new class of failure with no actionable remediation (e.g., “Validating stuck” with no artifacts).
Observability triggers
- Metric cardinality explosion, dropped metrics, or missing spans that prevent diagnosis.

Monitoring plan (what we watch during rollout)
Dashboards (primary)
- Provision-to-ready overview: P50/P95, counts by state, success rate
- Step-level breakdown: durations and failures by step (Provisioning vs Validating)
- Quarantine dashboard: counts, reasons, time-in-quarantine, override events
- Validation flake dashboard: NCCL and networking checks

On-call checks during rollout window
- 30-min cadence check-in during the first 6 hours after enablement for Stage 2 and Stage 3 increments.
- Confirm no “stuck in Validating” backlog building.

Paging vs ticketing posture (initial)
- First 24–48h: page only for customer-impacting capacity shortfall or control-plane state write failures; everything else is tickets.
- After stability: graduate alerts per SLO doc to paging thresholds.

Release train / change window alignment
- Preferred enablement day: Tuesday/Wednesday (so we have business hours coverage + follow-up days).
- Avoid:
  - Friday enablement unless explicitly approved by SRE + Infra leads.
  - Known infra maintenance windows / cloud provider planned events.
- Release train notes:
  - Add entry in weekly release summary: what flags changed, scope, and rollback owner.

Comms plan

Channels
- #eng-releases: announcement of stage start/stop, and where status updates live.
- #eng-infra: operational updates and live debugging.
- #eng-sre: alerting posture changes, escalation, incident coordination.
- #eng-platform: control-plane API/state-machine issues.
- Support/CS (as needed): heads-up for canary customer expansions.

Templates
- Stage enablement announcement (post in #eng-releases)
  - What: enable <flags> for <scope>
  - When: <timestamp + timezone>
  - Owner: <DRI>
  - Monitoring: <dashboard links>
  - Rollback: <kill switch + owner>
  - Expected impact: <none / faster readiness / potential delays>

- Rollback announcement
  - Trigger: <metric + threshold>
  - Action taken: <flags off / image rollback>
  - Customer impact: <if any>
  - Next update: <time>

Stakeholder updates (weekly)
- Send short summary to leadership thread (Irene/Neha/Priya per kickoff email): delta in P50/P95, top failure modes, and next expansion scope.

Dependencies / open questions
- Finalize feature flag keys and scope semantics (confirm in PR-18433).
- Confirm Terraform variables and defaults for limiting early rollout to us-east A100 (PR-399) and required tags/outputs (PR-391).
- Confirm readiness service authz: who can mutate state vs read-only (need audit trail when image channel changes).
- NCCL smoke test: default timeout and retry policy to reduce flakes; criteria for disabling quickly without code deploy.
- Customer canary selection: which Dedicated pool expansion event we can coordinate with CSM/Support.

Appendix: Known risks + mitigations (draft)
- Risk: Readiness gate causes capacity shortfall if validations are overly strict.
  - Mitigation: conservative quarantine thresholds; soft rollback available; watch quarantine-to-capacity ratio.
- Risk: Validation flakes create noise and reduce confidence.
  - Mitigation: start with minimal validation suite; run NCCL checks only after baseline stability; instrument flake rate.
- Risk: Metric tag/cardinality regression breaks dashboards/alerts.
  - Mitigation: pre-flight review of metric dimensions; guardrails in code; validate in Stage 1 before paging.

Changelog
- 2025-10-07: Initial draft created (Connor).
- 2025-10-12: Added rollback triggers + comms templates; aligned to us-east A100 first stage.
- 2025-10-18: Updated stage sequence to separate gate enforcement from orchestration enablement; added quarantine posture section.
